chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi 'Abdillah, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sulayman ibn Hilal, who said:

I said to Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'The family of so-and-so, some of them are righteous with the others and maintain ties (of kinship).' He said: 'Then their wealth will grow and they will grow, and they will not cease to be in that until they cut off (the kinship). So if they do that, it will vanish from them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual and material consequence of maintaining versus severing family ties according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the spiritual and material causality of *silat al-rahim*, noting that mutual connectivity fosters the multiplication of wealth and progeny. He warns that the eventual severance of these ties (*qata'*) results in the withdrawal of these divine blessings, a concept deeply rooted in the Shia understanding of *barakah* as contingent upon familial cohesion.
